newsitem.title: UK: Softer Atlantic Panamaxes take BFI down 5 to 1506.
newsitem.headline: Softer Atlantic Panamaxes take BFI down 5 to 1506.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down five at 1506 points on Wednesday as softer rates for Panamaxes in the Atlantic continue to outweigh firmer Capers.

South Korean charterers are said to have fixed Thetis 73,600 dwt dely US Gulf end-Jan trip Far East at a weaker $15,000 daily plus $290,000 bonus. But Panamaxes are still obtaining firm rates from the North Continent/Baltic. Marquesa 70,312 dwt has been fixed by K Line dely Seaforth early Feb for a trip via Narvik with iron ore to Cigading at $16,200 daily.

Firmer Caper rates were seen again on Wednesday, for example Excelsior 100,000/10 coal Baltimore/Ensted early Feb at $7.50 to Elsam, who also fixed Chrismir for 140,000/10 coal Richards Bay/Ensted for early Feb at $8.75.
Conditions stayed weak for Handies in the grain trades from US Gulf and E Coast S America.
